name: Gmail
hint: A web OAuth client in your Google Cloud project with the Gmail API enabled, and one account’s refresh token for this scope under https://www.googleapis.com/auth/: gmail.modify, for example from the OAuth 2.0 Playground; an External app left in Testing gets tokens that end after 7 days.

endpoints.name: list_messages
endpoints.description: Lists the mailbox’s messages as an id and threadId each; get_message returns one’s content. q takes Gmail search-box syntax, e.g. from:ann@example.com is:unread, and userId is me.

notes.userId: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.
notes.q: Only return messages matching the specified query. Supports the same query format as the Gmail search box. For example, `"from:someuser@example.com rfc822msgid: is:unread"`. Parameter cannot be used when accessing the api using the gmail.metadata scope.
notes.labelIds: Only return messages with labels that match all of the specified label IDs. Messages in a thread might have labels that other messages in the same thread don't have. To learn more, see [Manage labels on messages and threads](https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/labels#manage_labe
notes.maxResults: Maximum number of messages to return. This field defaults to 100. The maximum allowed value for this field is 500.
notes.pageToken: Page token to retrieve a specific page of results in the list.
notes.includeSpamTrash: Include messages from `SPAM` and `TRASH` in the results.

endpoints.name: get_message
endpoints.description: Returns one message; userId is me. format is full (the default: headers and body parts in payload, each body’s data base64url-encoded), metadata (labels and headers only, those in metadataHeaders if given), minimal or raw.

notes.userId: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.
notes.id: The ID of the message to retrieve. This ID is usually retrieved using `messages.list`. The ID is also contained in the result when a message is inserted (`messages.insert`) or imported (`messages.import`).
notes.format: The format to return the message in.
notes.metadataHeaders: When given and format is `METADATA`, only include headers specified.

endpoints.name: list_threads
endpoints.description: Lists the mailbox’s conversations without their messages; get_thread returns one’s messages. q takes Gmail search-box syntax, e.g. from:ann@example.com is:unread, and userId is me.

notes.userId: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.
notes.q: Only return threads matching the specified query. Supports the same query format as the Gmail search box. For example, `"from:someuser@example.com rfc822msgid: is:unread"`. Parameter cannot be used when accessing the api using the gmail.metadata scope.
notes.labelIds: Only return threads with labels that match all of the specified label IDs.
notes.maxResults: Maximum number of threads to return. This field defaults to 100. The maximum allowed value for this field is 500.
notes.pageToken: Page token to retrieve a specific page of results in the list.
notes.includeSpamTrash: Include threads from `SPAM` and `TRASH` in the results.

endpoints.name: get_thread
endpoints.description: Returns one conversation with all its messages; userId is me. format is full (the default: headers and body parts in payload, each body’s data base64url-encoded), metadata (labels and headers only, those in metadataHeaders if given) or minimal.

notes.userId: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.
notes.id: The ID of the thread to retrieve.
notes.format: The format to return the messages in.
notes.metadataHeaders: When given and format is METADATA, only include headers specified.

endpoints.name: list_labels
endpoints.description: Lists the mailbox’s labels, system and user, each with its id, name and type; those ids are what labelIds and modify_message_labels take. userId is me.

notes.userId: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

endpoints.name: get_label
endpoints.description: Returns one label with its total and unread counts of messages and threads. userId is me.

notes.userId: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.
notes.id: The ID of the label to retrieve.

endpoints.name: list_drafts
endpoints.description: Lists drafts as an id each, with only the id and threadId of its message; get_draft returns one’s content. q takes Gmail search-box syntax, and userId is me.

notes.userId: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.
notes.q: Only return draft messages matching the specified query. Supports the same query format as the Gmail search box. For example, `"from:someuser@example.com rfc822msgid: is:unread"`.
notes.maxResults: Maximum number of drafts to return. This field defaults to 100. The maximum allowed value for this field is 500.
notes.pageToken: Page token to retrieve a specific page of results in the list.

endpoints.name: get_draft
endpoints.description: Returns one draft and its message; userId is me. format is full (the default: headers and body parts in payload, each body’s data base64url-encoded), metadata, minimal or raw.

notes.userId: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.
notes.id: The ID of the draft to retrieve.
notes.format: The format to return the draft in.

endpoints.name: get_profile
endpoints.description: Returns the signed-in account’s email address and its total messages and threads. userId is me.

notes.userId: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

endpoints.name: send_message
endpoints.description: Sends an email to the recipients in its To, Cc and Bcc headers; userId is me. A reply stays in its thread only with the thread’s threadId, In-Reply-To and References headers in the raw message, and the same Subject. Body: {"raw": "<base64url of an RFC 2822 message>", "threadId"}.

notes.userId: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

endpoints.name: create_draft
endpoints.description: Saves an email as a draft without sending it; userId is me. A reply stays in its thread as in send_message. Body: {"message": {"raw": "<base64url of an RFC 2822 message>", "threadId"}}.

notes.userId: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

endpoints.name: modify_message_labels
endpoints.description: Adds or removes labels on one message, up to 100 of each, by the ids list_labels returns, INBOX and UNREAD included; userId is me. Body: {"addLabelIds": [label ids], "removeLabelIds": [label ids]}.

notes.userId: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.
notes.id: The ID of the message to modify.

endpoints.name: create_label
endpoints.description: Creates a user label, whose name may not be a system label’s; userId is me. Body: {"name", "labelListVisibility": "labelShow", "messageListVisibility": "show"}.

notes.userId: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.
